decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the land shall be restored to the state as specified in the notes attached to this condition no later than the 27/03/2015 or when the use has permanently ceased, whichever is the earlier, in accordance with the approved plans and supporting information as detailed in Condition 2 below.
The temporary marquees shall only be used on the dates specified within this application, principally:
 	Saturday 08 November 2014
 	Saturday 15 November 2014
 	Saturday 22 November 2014
 	Saturday 29 November 2014
 	Saturday 14 February 2015
 	Saturday 14 March 2015
 	Saturday 21 March 2015  
The land shall be restored to the state as indicated on drawing no. L-700 as submitted.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (listed above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) ref 47070199 dated August 2014 produced by URS and the mitigation measures detailed within the FRA.
The mitigation measures shall be fully implemented prior to occupation and subsequently in accordance with the timing/phasing arrangements embodied within the scheme, or within any other period as may subsequently be agreed, in writing, by the local planning authority.
description: Erection of a temporary hospitality facility on land adjacent to the self-storage facility and an associated temporary bridge link over Whitton Brook between October and March to be used only in association with Autumn Rugby Internationals and Six Nations Championships, associated landscaping works to the land bordering Whitton Brook and Rugby Road and the creation of an emergency means of access for the Environment Agency to the Whitton Brook from Rugby Road
